description: Token-Sheriff is a comprehensive library for offline JWT token validation in multi-issuer environments, with a strong focus on security. It ships a core validation library plus Quarkus runtime/deployment extensions, a client, benchmarking suites, and E2E test harnesses.
description_reasoning: source: README.md 'What is it?' and 'Motivation' sections

benchmark-core.description: JMH micro-benchmarks for the token-sheriff-validation library. Measures in-process token validation throughput and latency across standard and delegate scenarios, with JFR-instrumented benchmark variants.

benchmark-integration-wrk.description: WRK-based HTTP load benchmarks for the deployed OAuth/JWT validation endpoints, with integration-test infrastructure and shell benchmark/ablation scripts orchestrating token fetch and endpoint stress runs.

benchmarking.description: Aggregator (parent) module for all benchmarking-related modules, including the JMH library benchmarks, WRK integration benchmarks, and shared benchmarking infrastructure.

benchmarking-common.description: Shared benchmarking infrastructure with JMH integration. Provides the benchmark runner, metrics collection and converters, JFR support, and report/output generation used to produce artifacts during benchmark execution.

documentation.description: Project-level documentation module holding the AsciiDoc specifications and READMEs for the commons, validation, client and OIDC capability areas, including the multi-plan OIDC restructure/implementation docs.

e-2-e-playwright-maven.description: Maven-side wrapper for the Playwright end-to-end tests of the Token-Sheriff Quarkus Dev-UI. Wires the npm Playwright suite into the Maven reactor via the e2e-tests profile and dev-environment start/stop scripts.

e-2-e-playwright-npm.description: Playwright end-to-end test suite for the Token-Sheriff Quarkus Dev-UI. Verifies status/config views, the token debugger and WCAG accessibility against a live dev environment, using Keycloak-issued tokens.

token-sheriff-bom.description: Bill of Materials (BOM) that centralizes and aligns dependency versions for all Token-Sheriff modules so consumers import a single managed version set.

token-sheriff-client.description: Framework-agnostic OIDC/OAuth client engine — the outbound counterpart to token-sheriff-validation. Implements provider discovery, client authentication (client_secret_basic/post, private_key_jwt, mTLS), the authorization-code flow with PKCE and PAR, client credentials, refresh with rotation and reuse detection, step-up authentication, DPoP proof generation, userinfo, introspection, revocation and RP-initiated end-session. Adds token lifecycle management (store, scheduler, id-token validation bridge) on the commons transport base.

token-sheriff-client-quarkus.description: Runtime module of the Quarkus extension for the Token-Sheriff OIDC/OAuth client engine. Exposes the framework-agnostic token-sheriff-client engine as ApplicationScoped CDI beans through TokenSheriffClientProducer, maps MicroProfile configuration onto ClientConfiguration via ClientRuntimeConfig and ClientConfigMapper, and maps TransportException to a JAX-RS response. Builds on the token-sheriff-validation-quarkus extension for the id-token validation bridge.

token-sheriff-client-quarkus-deployment.description: Deployment (build-time) module of the Quarkus extension for the Token-Sheriff OIDC/OAuth client engine. Its TokenSheriffClientProcessor build steps register the token-sheriff-client feature during augmentation and contribute TokenSheriffClientProducer to the CDI bean archive, since the extension runtime jar is not part of the application's bean-discovery archive by default.

token-sheriff-parent.description: Root reactor and parent POM for the Token-Sheriff project. Aggregates all modules (validation core, client, Quarkus extensions, benchmarking, docs and E2E) and centralizes shared build configuration, inheriting from cui-java-parent.

token-sheriff-quarkus-integration-tests.description: Integration tests for the Token-Sheriff Quarkus extension. Stands up test endpoints and exercises token validation, bearer-token, health, security and API behavior against a real Keycloak, including native-container testing with HTTPS.

token-sheriff-quarkus-parent.description: Parent (aggregator) module for the Token-Sheriff Quarkus integration. Groups the validation and client runtime/deployment extensions, integration tests and E2E Playwright modules, and centralizes their shared build configuration (including SecurityEvents-to-Micrometer integration).

token-sheriff-validation.description: Core library for offline OAuth/JWT token validation in multi-issuer environments. Provides the TokenValidator entry point, issuer configuration, staged validation pipelines for access/id/refresh tokens, JWKS loading, signature verification, JWE decryption, DPoP proof validation, and token caching, using standard JDK cryptographic providers.

token-sheriff-validation-quarkus.description: Runtime module of the Quarkus extension for OAuth/JWT token validation. Exposes token-sheriff-validation as CDI producers, maps YAML/MicroProfile configuration to issuer configs, integrates SecurityEvents into Micrometer metrics, adds SmallRye health checks, a bearer-token servlet layer, JWE support and error mapping.

token-sheriff-validation-quarkus-deploym.description: Build-time deployment module of the Quarkus validation extension. Provides the extension processor/build steps and ships the Dev-UI web components (JWT debugger and status/config views) that surface validation state during development.

npm/JavaScript side of the validation Quarkus deployment module. Builds, lints, formats and unit-tests (Jest) the Lit-based Dev-UI web components (qwc-jwt-debugger, qwc-jwt-status-config) shipped by the extension.
